info.name: Project a depth-bounded Context Graph rooted at an entity

params.name: view
params.description: Perspective. `service` is rooted at a business service. `ai_system` is rooted at an AI system and walks bindings to their scope targets. `decision_surface` is rooted at a surface and emits parent process / business service plus AI systems bound directly to the surface.

params.name: id
params.description: Root entity id. For view=service this is the business_service id.

params.name: depth
params.description: Maximum BFS hops from the root, treating edges as undirected. Values above 5 are silently clamped to 5; negative or non-numeric values return 400.

items.docs:
Returns a generic node/edge projection of business and operational context rooted at the entity identified by (view, id). Supported views: `service` (rooted at a BusinessService), `ai_system` (rooted at an AI system), `decision_surface` (rooted at a surface).
Node kinds: business_service, related_business_service, capability, process, decision_surface, ai_system, ai_system_binding, authority_summary, coverage.
Edge kinds (all directed): relates_to, has_capability, has_process, has_surface, bound

info.name: Project a depth-bounded Authority Graph rooted at a business service

params.name: view
params.description: Perspective. Only `service` is supported at MVP — root at a business service and walk the authority spine.

params.name: id
params.description: Root entity id. For view=service this is the business_service id.

params.name: depth
params.description: Maximum BFS hops from the root, treating edges as undirected. Default 4 reaches agent nodes. Values above 5 are silently clamped to 5; negative or non-numeric values return 400.

items.docs:
Returns a generic node/edge projection of the authority spine rooted at a business service. Answers the operator question: "for this business service, which decision surfaces are governed by which authority profiles, which grants, which agents, and which fail-mode policies?"
Node kinds (7): business_service, decision_surface, authority_profile, authority_grant, agent, fail_mode_policy, escalation_target.
Edge kinds (7, all directed): business_service_has_surface (bs → surface), surface_uses_prof
